title: Backend foundation: Hono bootstrap, auth middleware, canonical errors
description: Scaffold backend service in apps/backend with Hono, environment bootstrap, Supabase JWT middleware for app routes, PAT middleware for plugin routes, and canonical API error envelope. Add /health endpoint and wire shared contracts package usage where applicable.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Backend exposes GET /health returning 200 with stable JSON body.
2) Canonical API error envelope implemented as { error: { code, message, details } }.
3) Supabase JWT middleware protects app routes and attaches authenticated user context.
4) PAT middleware protects plugin routes and validates non-revoked hash-backed tokens.
5) Route boundary tests prove app JWT cannot access plugin routes and PAT cannot access app routes.
6) Automated tests added for /health, env validation, auth middleware failure/success paths, and error envelope mapping.
7) Quality gates pass: bun run check, bun run typecheck, bun run test.

title: Plugin events ingest: validate, idempotency, session_events persistence
description: Implement POST /v1/plugin/events in backend. Validate payloads with shared contracts, authenticate via PAT middleware, persist canonical events to session_events, dedupe by event_id, and return accepted/deduped counts with structured errors.
acceptance_criteria:
1) POST /v1/plugin/events requires valid PAT auth.
2) Request payload validates against shared contracts schemas.
3) Events persist to session_events with correct user/device attribution.
4) Duplicate event_id values are idempotent and counted as deduped (not reinserted).
5) Response returns accepted, deduped, and per-event errors in canonical shape.
6) Batch ingest behavior covered by tests including mixed valid/duplicate/invalid events.
7) Quality gates pass: bun run check, bun run typecheck, bun run test.

title: Fix CI failure: Biome checking .beads runtime files
description: CI fails because biome check scans .beads runtime/export files (.beads/metadata.json and .beads/export-state/*.json). Fix by excluding .beads/** from biome file checks (and optionally root .gitignore if we choose to stop tracking .beads artifacts). Verify bun run check and bun run ci pass after change.
